title: Team of Teams
summary: Growing a four-person design group into a practice of eighteen across three product areas, without losing the habits that made it good.
inspect: Growing a design practice from four to eighteen people without losing its habits.
statement: A team grows well when the way it works is written down, practised in the open and owned by everyone in it.
tapLine: The first critique ritual was drawn on a napkin.

title: Shared Foundations
summary: A design system and front-end platform that twelve product teams now build on, shipped as code first and documentation second.
inspect: A design system and platform that twelve teams build on.
statement: The platform worked the day teams stopped asking whether to use it and started asking how to change it.
tapLine: The button component has 214 tests and one joke.

title: Front Door
summary: One application journey for a public service, redesigned across web, phone and counter so every channel asks the same questions in the same order.
inspect: One application journey across web, phone and counter.
statement: People do not see channels. They see one service, and it should remember what they already told it.
tapLine: The best question we removed was asked for 11 years.
